name: marmo-lake
description: Marmo Lake local-first workspace for shops, classrooms, and small teams.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000; fi
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && if [ -x .venv/bin/pytest ]; then .venv/bin/pytest; else pytest; fi
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff format app; else ruff format app; fi
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check app; else ruff check app; fi
